docstring:
Erdős and Gyárfás [ErGy99] showed this property fails for infinitely many $r$ if we replace $r^2+1$
by $r^2$.
references: [ErGy99](https://doi.org/10.1016/S0012-365X(98)00323-9) Erdős, Paul and Gyárfás, András, Split and balanced colorings of complete graphs. Discrete Math. (1999), 79-86.
type_pretty:
{r |
    ∃ V x x_1,
      Fintype.card V = r ^ 2 ∧
        ∃ coloring,
          ∀ (S : Finset V), S.card = r + 1 → ∀ (k : Fin r), ∃ u ∈ S, ∃ v ∈ S, u ≠ v ∧ coloring s(u, v) = k}.Infinite
